headline: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO Following Scandal
summary: Jensen Huang has returned as CEO of Nvidia, prompting a rally in the company's shares and the broader tech sector. Despite his return, Huang continues to face congressional scrutiny regarding his past conduct and national security implications.
why: Nvidia is a central player in the global semiconductor and artificial intelligence markets, making its leadership stability critical for investor sentiment in the tech sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The return of the CEO was received positively by the market, driving share prices higher.
